text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 20, 2023) for 56 Treverton Drive.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Rescinded Items 1 and 2 only of the Property Standards Order (April 20, 2023) for 56 Treverton Drive, Folder Number: 21 224679 PRS 00 IV, as the Municipal Licensing and Standards Division staff have confirmed that Municipal Licensing and Standards does not have jurisdiction on those Items as stated in the Property Standards Order. 2. Confirmed Item 3 only of the Property Standards Order (April 20, 2023) for 56 Treverton Drive, Folder Number: 21 224679 PRS 00 IV and in doing so granted an extension of time to comply to January 31, 2024.
